assertions.rationale: Expected utility uses model probability; simulation control claim with incompletely specified action semantics.
Argmax feasible expected utility specified; reported DQ but implementation details missing.
Posterior integration influences utilities; no explicit risk budget across posterior tails.
Repeated action/state simulation claimed; explicit environment response/action execution attribution is incomplete.
Feasibility filtering specified, but actual bounds/fail behavior not reported.
Latency<100ms N<50 and latency plots reported, hardware/load absent.
Anonymization/noPII/encrypted institutional storage explicitly stated only in respondent statement; data provenance conflict limits attribution.
Named IRB and Helsinki scope stated; statement conflicts with synthetic-only evaluation, so approval claim not human-study proof.
Synthetic startup decision-quality/robustness compared across baselines; no clinical utility.
Hidden discrete state evolves between simulation steps and feeds decisions; no neural representation implied.

legacy_cells.B: Scalable Bayesian–XAI Framework for Multi-Objective Decision-Making in Uncertain Dynamic Systems
legacy_cells.C: Mostafa Aboulnour Salem, Zeyad Aly Khalil
legacy_cells.I: 019_2026_Scalable Bayesian–XAI Framework for Multi-Objective Decision-Making in Uncertain Dynamic Systems.pdf
legacy_cells.AI: Synthetic tabular observations of demand, financial capacity, operational stability, and risk
legacy_cells.AT: Sequential Bayesian posterior/belief update from new observations
legacy_cells.BN: Dynamic Bayesian-network DAG with causal-ordering and conditional-independence assumptions; Dirichlet priors for CPTs
legacy_cells.BS: Gaussian observation model; probability indicators, scenario comparisons, and decision actions
legacy_cells.BU: Maximize expected multi-objective utility (weighted performance, risk, and resource-efficiency objectives), subject to C(xt, at) ≤ δ
legacy_cells.CK: Expected-utility maximization over actions subject to system constraints C(xt, at) ≤ δ
legacy_cells.EC: Decision quality, robustness, and transparency evaluated; authors report the proposed framework outperformed baselines across performance indicators, but exact plotted values are not present in the extracted text
legacy_cells.EG: Reported latency: <100 ms for N<50; moderate increase for 50<N<100; real-time performance degrades for N>100 without approximation
legacy_cells.EI: Compared with AHP/TOPSIS, static Bayesian network, Random Forest with SHAP, and LIME; authors report higher performance indicators for the proposed framework, without exact plotted values in extracted text
legacy_cells.FL: User-provided observations → Bayesian state/belief estimation with dynamic Bayesian-network transitions and observation model → SHAP/sensitivity explanation → expected-utility action optimization with constraint filtering → visualization; evaluated in synthetic simulation
legacy_cells.FM: Integrates Bayesian probabilistic reasoning, stochastic control, and multi-objective expected utility with intrinsic and SHAP-based post hoc explainability in a dynamic decision framework
legacy_cells.FN: Simulation uses 370 synthetic observations; the authors report improved decision quality, robustness, and transparency over baselines, but exact numerical figure values are unavailable in the extracted text
legacy_cells.FO: Authors report dependence on expert specification of variables/dependencies, sensitivity to poor-quality or incomplete data, computational degradation in high-dimensional systems, and need for real-world validation; evaluation uses synthetic data and no empirical user study
legacy_cells.FP: Authors propose validation on real-world datasets, expansion to larger/diverse domains, improved scalable inference, automated structure learning, real-time data integration, and improved human–AI interaction
legacy_cells.FQ: Authors identify a gap in combining probabilistic modelling, explainability, and dynamic decision control, particularly continuous updating, real-time feedback, and integrated post hoc explanations
legacy_cells.FR: The evaluation is a synthetic startup decision scenario, not a healthcare cohort or health-system study; healthcare application is future work. No clinical validation, external validation, prospective evidence, or exact numerical performance values are shown in the extracted text.
legacy_cells.FT: A reusable design lesson is to keep probabilistic state updating, explanation consistency checks, expected-utility scoring, and constraint filtering explicit as separate steps in a closed-loop pipeline.
legacy_cells.FX: Read the complete extracted PDF, pages 1–23: title/abstract; Introduction; Literature Review; System Design and Architecture; MODMC Framework; Simulation Validation (scenario, inference, updating, metrics, explainability, performance and scalability); Limitations and Benefits; Conclusions; Future Research Directions; ethics, data availability, and other statements; and references. Relevant text/table/figure descriptions were inspected, including Table 1 and Figures 2–6. Figures are represented by captions and narrative descriptions in the extracted text; exact plotted numerical values were not extractable from this text. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: The paper is not a healthcare study: its evaluated example is a synthetic startup decision scenario, and healthcare is named only as future validation. Confidence is Medium because the extracted PDF text omits exact values shown graphically in Figures 2–6; these values were not inferred. Action conditioning is recorded as model structure, not causal identification. A:I are not included in values, preserving the prefilled workbook fields. Evidence QA: 44/56 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (78.6%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 55 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 4 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: Non-healthcare startup synthetic simulation; healthcare is future work.
Synthetic observations/simulated-user-only description conflicts with IRB/respondent/consent statement; no R4 inferred.
Fixed random generator W/B versus fitted transition attribution not fully specified; generic control claimed but capability unresolved.
Paired-test significance and95%CI claimed without run counts,interval values or test details.
Latency lacks hardware/load; explanation scores are not human trust or probability calibration.
DAG causal labels and covariate perturbations do not establish identified clinical effects.
No code/repository/supplement inspected or independent human entailment review.
notes: All23physical pages read incl refs21–23. Table1 and Figs1–6 visually inspected. Figure1 includes directed feedback cycles although text calls network DAG; temporal unrolling unclear. Membership non-healthcare supporting component only; never count as healthcareWM.
